title: Viral titration by the Plaque assay
author: Elen Mello de Souza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jqxcmxn
materials: Maintain in RPMI 1640 medium (Cultilab) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (Cultilab), 2 mM L-glutamine (Gibco) and 100U/50µg penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich) for 24 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Count viral plaques for calculate plaque-forming unit (PFU).

steps.title: Seed Vero cells
steps.instruction: Seed Vero lineage cells (kidney epithelial cells from African green monkey) in 24-well plates at a density of 2 x 10^5 cells/well.

steps.title: Prepare viral dilutions
steps.instruction: Prepare serial ten-fold dilutions of viral suspension in sterile dilution tubes, ranging from 10^-1 up to 10^-10.

steps.title: Inoculate Vero cell monolayers
steps.instruction: Label the 24-well plate containing confluent Vero cell monolayers and inoculate with viral suspensions.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl of the undiluted viral suspension into each of two wells.
Add 100 µl of each serial dilution into each of two wells.
Maintain two wells without infection as controls.

steps.title: Allow virus adsorption
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated plate at 37°C for 1 hour in a 5% CO2 incubator.

steps.title: Apply overlay medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 3% semi-solid carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) overlay medium to each well to limit virus diffusion.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Maintain the plate for seven days at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.

steps.title: Fix cell monolayers
steps.instruction: Fix the cell monolayers using 10% formol.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the cell monolayer with 1 ml of 10% formol for a minimum of 18 hours at room temperature.
Remove the overlay medium and the fixer.

steps.title: Wash and stain monolayers
steps.instruction: Wash and stain the fixed cell monolayers.

substeps.instruction: Wash the cell monolayer in running water 3 times.
Stain the cell monolayer with 1 ml of 0.04% Violet crystal for 1 hour at room temperature.
